management_steps.details: Pinworm (Children > 1 year and adults): 100 mg as a single dose and repeated after 2 weeks. Other helminths excluding pinworm and tapeworm: Children 1-2 years: 100 mg 12 hourly for 3 days. Children >= 2 years and adults: 500 mg as a single dose.
